create.semantic: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS semantic (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT, source TEXT, metadata JSONB, embedding VECTOR(1536) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW())

fetch.messages: SELECT role, content FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at ASC
fetch.similar_documents: SELECT id, title, content , category, 1 - (embedding <=>  $1::vector) AS similarity FROM semantic ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::vector LIMIT $2

save.embedding: INSERT INTO semantic (id, title, content, category, source, metadata, embedding) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)

edit.document: UPDATE semantic SET title = $1, content = $2, category = $3, source = $4, metadata = $5, embedding = $6, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $7
